160	And time passed, days went by, years went by, and the son of the one who saved him fell into a bad

161	financial situation.

162	Everything starts falling apart at home.

163	Until he went up to the attic and found this bag that his father had received for saving that

164	young man.

165	So he said, this bag must be worth a few shekels.

166	He took the bag...

167	and said, let's see, why is it so bulging?

168	Maybe they just stuffed it, usually they put all kinds of papers in a bag like this to make it look nice.

169	He opened the bag, and it was full of money, gold, precious stones, diamonds.

170	That is the whole idea of what HaShem comes to teach, as we learned here in the Parashah.

171	I told Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov the Name of mercy.

172	They knew there was such a thing, the Name of mercy.

173	But what is that Name?

174	What is it really?

175	What is inside?

176	He did not know.

177	And this is what Rashi writes: not "I did not inform," but "I was not made known."

178	I did not make Myself known to them in My true measure.

179	They knew I was merciful, but they did not yet know how much mercy I have.

180	And this is what He says to him: I was not made known to them.

181	"And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians enslave, and I have taken out, and I have saved, and I have redeemed, and I have taken, 

182	and I have brought."

183	There are five expressions here, apparently five expressions of redemption, and indeed in the Haggadah of Pesach we are in doubt

184	how many expressions there are, five or four?

185	We say there are four expressions of redemption.

186	"I took out," "I redeemed," "I took," "I saved."

187	"I brought" — we are in doubt.

188	Whether it is another expression or a synonym.

189	That is why you will see in the Haggadah of Pesach that we drink four cups.

190	Four cups on the night of the Seder, we drink four cups.

191	Why?

192	Because of the four expressions of redemption mentioned here.

193	"I will take you out, and I will save, and I will redeem, and I will take."

194	What is "and I will bring"?

195	Is it a fourth expression?

196	Is it a fifth expression?

197	Or is it a synonym?

198	We don't know.

199	So what do we do on the Seder night?
